name: keryx-mcp

tools.name: research_monthly
tools.description: Read the four-request, 30-day Research Monthly quote and handoff. The current quote identifies its payment network. Never buys or redeems a plan.

tools.name: keryx_operator_status
tools.description: Observe public prepaid research operations, queue and hold/review rationale. No spending or execution authority; exact books and customer jobs stay private.

tools.name: ask_keryx
tools.description: Ask Keryx — an autonomous research agent that buys paid sources under a budget, answers with inline citations, and pays each cited creator in USDC on Arc. Default deep-mode price is 0.05 USDC service fee + 0.05 USDC creator budget; the POST body sets the exact price. Paid from your own funded Arc Testnet wallet (eip155:5042002; run keryx_wallet_status first). Public research may send your question to Keryx's search provider. The source USDC budget is separate from model and search operating costs. Use when you want a grounded, source-cited answer AND the creators paid for their work.

question.description: The research question to ask Keryx.

budget.description: Optional prepaid creator-spend cap in USDC (default 0.05); added to the deep-mode service fee.

tools.name: keryx_recover
tools.description: Read the saved payment attempt and poll its query ID without submitting another payment. Use after a paid error or uncertain network outcome.

tools.name: keryx_wallet_status
tools.description: Show the configured Arc Testnet wallet (eip155:5042002) the Keryx MCP server pays from: address, balances and readiness. Testnet funds are available through the Circle faucet. Run this before ask_keryx.
